angleRead.text: The Oaks' inconsistent performance has me wondering what's going on behind the scenes. After a strong start, they lost to the Pacers despite a late surge, but then bounced back with a dominating win over the Raptors. I'm going to dig into the team's dynamics and see if I can get a sense of what's driving these ups and downs. I'll be looking at the players' stats and quotes, as well as talking to people around the team to get a feel for the mood.
